verdict.rationale: Similarity search by URL is a fair axis for a web search API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents finding pages similar to a given URL. The documented URL inputs (Exa Contents) only extract content from URLs you already have, and the search endpoints take natural-language queries. That is an adjacent capability, not similarity search, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can find pages similar to a URL I already have
